name: 🍎[FLING] Newton's Sandbox
desc:
🍎 An apple once fell from a tree and hit a guy's head. Over 300 years later, we have THIS GAME!!

⚡ Use your GRABLINE to grab, slam, and fling various objects.
🏝️ Explore a PLAYGROUND with interactive CONTRAPTIONS.
⚔️ Toss ENEMIES off the map and dominate the island.

Extensively inspired by Fling Things and People created by Horomori.

llm.loop: grab objects and players with a grabline -> slam and fling them -> play with contraptions -> earn coins to unlock toys, beams and upgrades
llm.objectives: fling things and players and dominate the island
llm.progression: coins, toy and beam unlocks, upgrades, saved plots
llm.instructions: use your grabline to grab, slam and fling objects, explore the playground of contraptions, toss enemies off the map
unique: Fling Things and People-style physics with buildable plots and contraptions
llm.thumbnails: grabline beam flinging a car and a monster truck, a ragdoll avatar, a sky island playground
llm.complexity_notes: networked physics grabbing, many interactive toys and contraptions, plot saving
